functions.source:
SELECT function_name AS name, function_type AS kind, parameter_types AS arguments,
      return_type AS result, varargs, stability, has_side_effects AS side_effects, internal
      FROM duckdb_functions() WHERE database_name='system'

keywords.source: SELECT keyword_name AS name, keyword_category AS category FROM duckdb_keywords()

types.source: SELECT type_name AS name, logical_type, type_category AS category FROM duckdb_types() WHERE internal

operators.source:
SELECT function_name AS name, parameter_types AS arguments, return_type AS result
      FROM duckdb_functions() WHERE database_name='system' AND NOT regexp_matches(function_name, '^[a-zA-Z_]')

casts.scope: implicit-only; explicit and contextual casts unverified

collations.source: SELECT collname AS name FROM pragma_collations()

settings.source: SELECT name, input_type AS type, scope FROM duckdb_settings()

extensions.source: SELECT extension_name AS name FROM duckdb_extensions()
